mapper.select: select ctgr.id, count(todos.id) as total_count, count(if(todos.is_completed = 0, 1, null)) as not_completed_count from categories ctgr left join todos on todos.category_id = ctgr.id and todos.user_id = ctgr.user_id where ctgr.user_id = #{userId} group by ctgr.id order by ctgr.id
select id, user_id, name, color, icon, created_at from categories where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, name, color, icon, created_at from categories where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
select id, user_id, name, color, icon, created_at from categories where user_id = #{userId} and name = #{name}
select id, name, user_id, color, icon, created_at from categories where id = #{categoryId}
select id, name, user_id, color, icon, created_at from categories where name = #{name} and user_id = #{userId}
